title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: threewaymsrt

three-way merge sort
three-way merge sort
(algorithm)
Definition:
A
k-way merge sort
which uses three input and three output streams.
See also
two-way merge sort
,
merge sort
,
balanced merge sort
.
